_comment: HAND-AUTHORED and NOT generated (merge-queue PRD section 11, D111). --spark-synchronize-model writes no file for
a type that only a List<string> reference reaches, and Repository.KnownChecks, the one property that holds
ForgeCheck values, is [IgnoreProperty]. The rows are served in memory by ForgeCheckActions' two Custom queries,
the options of the merge queue's exclusion lists; each row's id is the check's name, which is what the lists store.
QueryRead is granted to signed-in users (security.json): without Read, GetHiddenReferencesAsync would remove the
two exclusion-list attributes altogether. The queries themselves answer managers only.
#554: Repository_PullRequestChecks (the checks seen on a pull request) feeds SetUpRulesets.RequiredChecks, whose
"Add new" names a check that has not reported yet. So Name is writable and required, and signed-in users hold New:
the confirm (PersistentObjectSavePath.ConfirmAsync) stores nothing and derives the row id from Name (IHasNaturalId).
